applies_to: source release bundle, not repository, backups, or separately provisioned hosting configuration

path_matching.path_format: root-relative forward-slash file paths, no leading slash

rules.reason: Version-control/CI metadata; no runtime dependency found.
Testing source, probes, fixtures and generated evidence; repository-only or ignored.
Installer/schema/seed/CLI initializer/maintenance are not required by normal runtime; optional backup schema handled separately.
Never package private workspace environment/credentials. Operator provisioning is separate.
Exclude workspace persistent/private state; only exact protective-file exceptions. Approved media/private provision are separate.
Historical backups, dumps, logs, temp/cache/session state are not source bundle.
Offline reports/documentation/release metadata are not web runtime.
Local/debug/setup scripts are excluded; do not use filename matches to remove known runtime dependencies.
Local/generated state; no vendor/node dependency found at current runtime. Re-audit if dependency changes.
Dumps/archives/keys/operator configuration; exact .user.ini exception is conditional.
Apply through reviewed hosting/operator configuration, not public source bundle.

exact_control_exceptions.condition: Required protective source file only; no storage contents.
Required protective source file only; no uploaded media.
Only if hosting condition in allowlist is satisfied; otherwise equivalent reviewed PHP settings are required.

evaluation_order: Reject unsafe path or symbolic link/junction and any file outside source root.
Match deny rules. Suppress a match only for the exact path and listed rule IDs in exact_control_exceptions, with its condition satisfied.
Any remaining deny match rejects the file, even if accidentally added to the allowlist.
If not denied, require exact membership in required_source_files or satisfied conditional_source_files. Reject all other files.
Verify all required source files exist in the final bundle and all local static/dynamic view/asset dependencies remain complete.
Validate final staged/bundle secret scan and archive contents; this policy alone is not evidence an archive was built safely.
separate_provisioning: No workspace .env/data/state is included. Approved persistent data and explicit private production environment are provisioned separately under allowlist contract.
backup_schema_note: database/schema.sql is optional input in backup handler; absent source file creates an empty installer entry, while actual schema/data SQL is generated from the live authorized DB. Requires later bundle runtime validation; do not treat optional installer entry as restore source.
